findings.issue: Schema-validation message row was replaced; its ID-less row is gone. MSG-P3-005 and MSG-P6-005 texts were invented although GAP-1096 keeps placeholders.
Start trigger 'POST /notices' conflicts with the story's POST /cases/{caseId}/notices path and is not in the item or sources.
BR8 adds event names FileDelivered and FileFailed that appear in no source; GAP-2106 only fixes the owner split.
Contract property sentence was rewritten with id/caseId required and a Notice validation rule that no item asked for.
Rule package row adds an approver (conduct and QA officer) that is in no source; GAP-1610 only covers the missing package name.
Proof-fields row adds a read mechanism through rwb-source-data by business date and barcode that no item or source supports.
AC14 scenarios state retry, reuse and failed-attempt behaviour not in any source. Also AC9 to AC13 are skipped (lint), which this edit leaves unresolved.
Contract test count is fourteen (01 to 14), not thirteen; the 'thirteen ... -01 to -13' wording in section 16 and the metadata row is wrong.
Contract row adds 'wave 2' timing that is in no source; GAP-1602 only says the layout is not stated.
